d: Pale pink, curly hair with a single braid falls to the shoulders, paired with narrow, pale blue eyes and a youthful, adolescent expression. The slender build is dressed in a blue and navy winter coat with white fur trimming, a brown leather belt, a black underskirt, white tights, and knee-high dark green boots with gold studs. Accessories include a white aviator cap with brass goggles, a brown leather shoulder bag, a rolled-up bedroll on the back, and a handheld climbing pick.
